observations: Photo 0: Black Canon DSLR body with 'Canon' logo; top plate shows '800' and lens is attached.
Photo 1: Rear view shows 'MENU/INFO' buttons and a live view screen; lens is attached.
Photo 2: Front/side view clearly shows 'EOS 800' on the body; lens attached; no visible lens model text beyond generic markings.

claims.claim: Neat UK used Canon 800D with 18-55mm lens
claims.evidence: Photos show Canon EOS 800D body (photos 0 and 2) and a zoom lens attached, but the lens focal-length range (18-55mm) is not clearly readable in the provided images.

risks.risk: Lens may not be the claimed 18-55mm kit lens (could be a different focal length or third-party lens).
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the lens front ring and side text showing the exact model/focal length (e.g., '18-55mm') plus a photo of the lens mount label.
risks.if_unproven: Price as Canon 800D body + unknown lens (worst case: not the claimed 18-55mm kit).

risks.risk: Camera may have shutter count issues, faults, or non-working functions (AF, buttons, ports, flash). Photos don’t confirm operation.
risks.proof: A short video showing: power on, menu navigation, autofocus on a moving subject, taking a photo, and playback on the screen.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully guaranteed working (worst case: treat as needing testing).

risks.risk: Battery/charger/accessories may be missing or not included (photos don’t show what’s in the box).
risks.proof: Photo of everything included laid out (battery, charger, cables, strap, lens caps) and a shot of the battery compartment.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming minimal/uncertain accessories (worst case: only camera + lens, no extras).

risks.risk: Sensor/mirror condition (dust, fungus, scratches) can’t be confirmed from these angles.
risks.proof: A photo of the sensor at f/22 (dust test) or a clear sample image showing dust spots, plus a close-up of the lens glass.
risks.if_unproven: Price as possible dust/fungus risk (worst case: require cleaning).

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the lens text/model showing it is exactly 18-55mm (and whether it’s Canon or third-party).
Video: power on → menu → autofocus on a subject → take a photo → playback.
Photo of all included items (battery, charger, caps, strap, memory card if any).
Sensor dust test photo (or sample image) and close-up of lens front element.
response.reason: The photos clearly show a Canon EOS 800D body, but the 18-55mm lens claim and full working condition are not fully provable from images alone; pricing should therefore use the worst-case assumptions while still matching the visible item.
